ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85:15 ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels to low-intensity (black/dark) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous central region of white pixels; dark pigmentation concentrated along the trailing edge and lateral tips; discrete vertical dark streaks located on the medial section of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an approximate 60-degree internal angle and a deep vertical bounding-box penetration.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration across the entire horizontal boundary; pixel amplitudes of peaks are most pronounced on the upper lateral margins of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoid curve characterized by a convex sweep from the notch transitioning into a concave upward trajectory toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dark pixel clusters with irregular edges localized at the extreme distal tips of both left and right fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, near-parallel vertical dark lines (linear pixel disruptions) originating from the trailing edge on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Linear vertical rake-like markings on the left lobe surface; irregular dark indentation on the far left distal margin.
other_distinctive_markers: Small dark spot clusters near the lower midline transition where the fluke enters the water surface.
